services.name: 30-Minute Intro Flight Lesson
services.desc: Experience the thrill of flying a gyroplane — a safe, stable, and incredibly fun aircraft that blends the best of a helicopter and airplane. On this 30-minute introductory flight lesson, you'll sit alongside a certified instructor who will guide you through the basics of flight. You'll have the opportunity to take the controls and fly the gyroplane yourself, all while enjoying sweeping views of the Kona Coast and Big Island's volcanic landscape. No experience is necessary — just bring your sense of adventure. services.name: 60-minute Gyroplane Flight Lesson
services.desc: 60-Minute Gyroplane Flight Lesson Get a full hour of hands-on flying time over the stunning Kona coast. This extended gyroplane lesson is ideal for those who want to dive deeper into the flight experience — whether you're just curious, building flight hours, or working toward your Sport Pilot license. You'll be flying with an FAA-certified gyroplane instructor in one of our two aircraft — choose between an open cockpit tandem or an enclosed side-by-side model.
